The Court made the following order:
 The Honourable Dr Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa
 Writ Petition No: 1512 Of 2025
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer for:
"...Pleased to Issue a Writ or Order or Direction more particularly one in the Nature of a Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondent Particularly the 3rd Respondent in not filing Charge Sheet or a Final Report in Connection with the Crime in F.I.R.No.311/2023 of Pendurthi P.S., Visakhapatnam

even though the stipulated period elapsed as well as abnormal delay, inspite of conclusion of investigation all are unlawful, Illegal, Violation of Article 14,19 of the Constitution of India , Consequently to direct the respondent officials to file a Charge Sheet / final Report in connection with the Crime in F.I.R.No.311/2024 of Pendurthy P.S.,
Visakhapatnam and pass....."

2. Heard Sri R Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri V.Farook, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the grievance of the petitioner is that police are not filing the charge-sheet/final report in Crime No.311/2024 for the offences under Section 376,
420 IPC, 3(1)(s),3(2)(va) SC ST POA Act on the file the Pendurthy Police Station, Vishakapatnam Commissionerate, even after lapse of two years from the date of registration of crime.
Learned counsel would further submit that a direction may be given to the respondent-police to conclude the investigation.
4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.
5. Considering the submissions, this writ petition is disposed of.

However, the police are directed to conclude the investigation and file a report according to the law as expeditiously as possible within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of copy of this order, if not filed by this date.
There shall be no order as to costs.
